SELECT j.*, h.start, h.`end`, h.starttime, h.place, h.price, h.duration, c.company_name, u.name AS user_name, cb.cabin_name, cb.cabin_class FROM jpdd j INNER JOIN `user` u ON j.userid = u.id LEFT JOIN hbxx h ON j.hbid = h.hbid LEFT JOIN company c ON h.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN hbxx_cabin cb ON j.cabin_id = cb.cabin_id
AND (h.start LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flightName}, '%') OR h.`end` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flightName}, '%'))
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
ORDER BY j.ordertime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jpdd j INNER JOIN `user` u ON j.userid = u.id LEFT JOIN hbxx h ON j.hbid = h.hbid LEFT JOIN company c ON h.company_id = c.company_id LEFT JOIN hbxx_cabin cb ON j.cabin_id = cb.cabin_id
AND (h.start LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flightName}, '%') OR h.`end` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{flightName}, '%'))
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
